Definition: Machalath, the name of an Ishmaelitess and of an Israelitess
BiblicalUsage: Machalath is a name worn by two women, and Scripture keeps them apart by their fathers. Esau took Mahalath, the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham's son, to be his wife, and Rehoboam took Mahalath, the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David, to wife, with Abihail the daughter of Eliab.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Mahalaths remind us that a name is not a person, and God knows each woman by her own father and her own house.
